title: Update landing-page service copy and add SEO phrase

requirements.summary: Improve the marketing descriptions for Carpet Cleaning, Mattress Cleaning, and AC Water Jet Service cards while keeping services, pricing, and CTAs unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/components/landing/Services.tsx, the description text for the following service cards is updated: 'Carpet Cleaning in Ahmedabad', 'Mattress Cleaning in Ahmedabad', and 'AC Water Jet Service in Ahmedabad'.
Service titles, pricing values, and the AC sub-service list/prices remain exactly as currently implemented.
No changes are made to any Call/WhatsApp/Instagram/Google Business Profile links or their destinations.

file_operations.description: Update only the description strings for the three specified service cards (Carpet Cleaning in Ahmedabad, Mattress Cleaning in Ahmedabad, AC Water Jet Service in Ahmedabad) to improved English marketing copy. Do not change service titles, any pricing values, the AC sub-service list items/prices, card order, or any CTA/link destinations.

requirements.summary: Insert the exact SEO phrase "sofa cleaning near me" into visible landing-page copy naturally, without changing structure or CTA destinations.

The phrase is added in a grammatically natural way (not repeated multiple times).
All existing CTA buttons/links (tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, Instagram, Google Business Profile) remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: Add the exact phrase "sofa cleaning near me" once within an existing visible paragraph (preferably the Hero supporting paragraph) in a natural English sentence. Do not change any CTA hrefs/destinations, and do not alter layout/structure beyond the text edit.

requirements.summary: Ensure any Hero headline/subheadline adjustments remain English-only and consistent with the Services offerings (Carpet, Mattress, AC Water Jet).

The Hero headline/subheadline continues to reference Carpet, Mattress, and AC services without implying any new services not present in the Services section.
